judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A pleasant but unremarkable blue sky with thin cirrus wisps that lacks the structure or light to be truly striking.
strengths: delicate wispy cirrus texture in the center
weaknesses: sparse composition with much empty blue
central cloud patch is faint and low-contrast
bright corner cloud is blown out and clipped
